استصححت (form X)
# اِسْتَصْحَحْتُ (istaṣḥaḥtu) /is.tasˤ.ħaħ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَصَحَّ (istaṣaḥḥa)
# اِسْتَصْحَحْتَ (istaṣḥaḥta) /is.tasˤ.ħaħ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَصَحَّ (istaṣaḥḥa)
# اِسْتَصْحَحْتِ (istaṣḥaḥti) /is.tasˤ.ħaħ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَصَحَّ (istaṣaḥḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
